piPackages.name: pi-herdr-agents
piPackages.gap: PMs run the newest npm release by the PM's decision (the author runs a git fork: upstream 3.3.1 + PRs #84, #95, #99, the solutionSpace change of closed PR #87, and the fork-only exit hold). Checked against 3.6.1 on 2026-10-30. Still missing: PR #84 is open upstream, so Escape in a running auto-exit child still closes it and the parent reports a failed run instead of leaving the pane open for the person; the exit-hold event channel (pi-herdr-agents:exit-hold, closed PR #89) does not exist, which matters only to an extension that waits out a quota reset (the author's quota-resume), not to a PM; there is no solutionSpace parameter on subagent (closed PR #87). Now carried upstream: #99 (a child without auto-exit is asked once whether it is done), #94 (an auto-exit child waits for the children it launched), and the /reload stale-context fix of #95 (session_shutdown clears the parent context).

piPackages.name: pi-lens
piPackages.gap: The author pins a git fork (wayne930242/pi-lens@1cdd03e: upstream master plus dispatch.disabledRunners, apmantza/pi-lens PR #5011, still open) to keep the dotnet-build runner off. npm 4.4.7 has no dispatch.disabledRunners key, so dotnet-build cannot be switched off. The profile ships no pi-lens config that uses it and PM repositories are not expected to hold .NET projects.

piPackages.name: pi-claude-bridge
piPackages.gap: PMs run the newest npm release by the PM's decision. Checked 2026-10-30: npm latest is still 0.9.3. The author's git fork (wayne930242/pi-claude-bridge@9822631) is that plus 33 unreleased upstream main commits and its own fixes, so what the fork has and 0.9.3 lacks includes: no Claude Code setting sources on the provider path (0.9.3 loads every source there), a pi 1.2.0+ requirement (0.9.3 accepts pi 0.86.1+), parallel tool calls lost after a non-streaming fallback (PR 225, open upstream), and a tool call pi never received keeping an MCP handler waiting (PR 226, open upstream).
